pages.title: Cabinet
pages.text: A single cabinet already has $(thing)36 slots$().$(br2)Unlike chests, it does not merge with a neighbouring cabinet, so you can line a whole wall with them and each one stays a big independent cupboard.$(br2)Ideal for a full wall of kitchen storage.

pages.title: Seven Materials
pages.text: There are seven materials; the recipe and function are identical and only the look changes:$(br)$(li)Andesite$(li)Diorite$(li)Granite$(li)Deepslate$(li)Blackstone$(li)Basalt$(li)Obsidian$(br2)Mix a row of them and the kitchen gets its atmosphere.$(br2)Note that everything inside drops out when you break a cabinet, so empty it before moving house.
